name: lanternfall-auto
note: lanternfall_auto: the bot plays from the start for 2400 frames along the checker's route through the real input struct (the spark's shrine, the first rooms of the Lantern Gate, enemies cleared on the way). Everything named is simulation, so every host agrees on it. A blow that lands holds the game still a few frames, so the tick runs behind the frame count. The control is one frame short.

name: lanternfall-play
note: lanternfall, one player on a pad as a person plays it: start, then run right, a tapped jump and a held one (the variable height), a strike, run left with a held jump, an upward strike, a running tapped jump, the map opened and closed. The player's place, the tick and the hash are pinned. The control runs the same way with no jumps and no strikes: it must differ.
